name: Geometry-Aware and Surface-Aligned Initialization
definition: Samples a fixed number of points $J$ around a 3D anchor point using a Gaussian distribution to cover the local surface patch for volume rendering constraints.
summary: Geometry-Aware and Surface-Aligned Initialization creates denser surface representations by sampling points around 3D anchors, distinguishing itself from standard Gaussian Splatting by explicitly modeling local surface patches.
